Project.0001.description: Project file needs to be converted to SDK-style. Modern .NET framework projects require a change in the project file format and use SDK corresponding to project flavor and functionality.
Project.0001.label: Project file needs to be converted to SDK-style

links.title: Overview of porting from .NET Framework to .NET

Project.0002.description:
Project's target framework(s) needs to be changed to the new target framework that you selected for this upgrade.

During upgrade target framework will be adjusted to corresponding platform when applicable. In some cases project would result in multiple target frameworks after the upgrade if it was using features that now have their own platforms in modern .NET frameworks (windows, iOS, Android etc).
Project.0002.label: Project's target framework(s) needs to be changed

links.title: Overview of porting from .NET Framework to .NET

Api.0002.description: API is source incompatible for selected .NET version: requires code changes to compile successfully when targeting a new version, such as removing obsolete APIs or changing method signatures.
Api.0002.label: Source incompatible for selected .NET version

LegacyConfiguration.description: Legacy XML-based configuration system (app.config/web.config) that has been replaced by a more flexible configuration model in .NET Core. The old system was rigid and XML-based. Migrate to Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration with JSON/environment variables; use System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager NuGet package as interim bridge if needed.
LegacyConfiguration.label: Legacy Configuration System

GdiDrawing.description: System.Drawing APIs for 2D graphics, imaging, and printing that are available via NuGet package System.Drawing.Common. Note: Not recommended for server scenarios due to Windows dependencies; consider cross-platform alternatives like SkiaSharp or ImageSharp for new code.
GdiDrawing.label: GDI+ / System.Drawing

Binding.0001.description: AutoGenerateBindingRedirects is explicitly set to false and no config file with manual binding redirects was found. The CLR will fail to load transitive dependencies at runtime because it defaults to strict version matching, causing FileLoadException.
Binding.0001.label: AutoGenerateBindingRedirects disabled with no manual redirects

NuGet.0002.description:
NuGet package upgrade is recommended for selected target framework.

Standard .NET packages are recommended to have versions matching version of .NET that project targets.

Some other packages also are known to work better for selected target frameworks.
NuGet.0002.label: NuGet package upgrade is recommended

NuGet.0003.description:
NuGet package functionality is included with framework reference.

Package needs to be removed.
NuGet.0003.label: NuGet package functionality is included with framework reference

Api.0003.description: API has a behavioral change in selected .NET version: code and binaries may behave differently at runtime without needing recompilation, but the new behavior might be undesirable and require updates.
Api.0003.label: Behavioral change in selected .NET version

Api.0001.description: API is binary incompatible for selected .NET version: affects existing binaries, often requiring recompilation, because the API has changed in a way that prevents older binaries from loading or executing.
Api.0001.label: Binary incompatible for selected .NET version

CodeDomDynamic.description: Runtime code generation, compilation, and scripting APIs including CodeDom and JScript that have limited support in .NET Core/.NET. These were used for dynamic code generation but are largely obsolete. Consider Roslyn APIs for code generation or alternative scripting solutions.
CodeDomDynamic.label: CodeDom & Dynamic Code Generation

CryptographyLegacy.description: Obsolete or insecure cryptographic algorithms that have been deprecated for security reasons. These algorithms are no longer considered secure by modern standards. Migrate to modern cryptographic APIs using secure algorithms.
CryptographyLegacy.label: Legacy Cryptography

SystemManagement.description: Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) APIs for system administration and monitoring that are available via NuGet package System.Management. These APIs provide access to Windows system information but are Windows-only; consider cross-platform alternatives for new code.
SystemManagement.label: System Management (WMI)

WinForms.description: Windows Forms APIs for building Windows desktop applications with traditional Forms-based UI that are available in .NET on Windows. Enable Windows Desktop support: Option 1 (Recommended): Target net9.0-windows; Option 2: Add <UseWindowsDesktop>true</UseWindowsDesktop>; Option 3 (Legacy): Use Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WindowsDesktop SDK.
WinForms.label: Windows Forms

Wpf.description: WPF APIs for building Windows desktop applications with XAML-based UI that are available in .NET on Windows. WPF provides rich desktop UI capabilities with data binding and styling. Enable Windows Desktop support: Option 1 (Recommended): Target net9.0-windows; Option 2: Add <UseWindowsDesktop>true</UseWindowsDesktop>.
Wpf.label: WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation)

Binding.0002.description: AutoGenerateBindingRedirects is set to false but manual binding redirects exist in the config file. Manual redirects may be incomplete — if any upgraded package is missing a corresponding redirect, the app will fail with FileLoadException at runtime.
Binding.0002.label: AutoGenerateBindingRedirects disabled with partial manual redirects

Binding.0005.description: Manual binding redirects exist but are missing a redirect for a referenced assembly with a version mismatch. This can cause MissingMethodException or FileLoadException when the missing redirect allows the app to start but fails when a specific code path is hit.
Binding.0005.label: Missing binding redirect for referenced assembly

Binding.0007.description: A binding redirect's newVersion is lower than the version provided by the NuGet package. This forced downgrade usually causes a load failure at runtime because the expected assembly version is not available.
Binding.0007.label: Binding redirect forces version downgrade

Binding.0008.description: An assembly reference version differs from the version provided by the target NuGet package and no binding redirect covers this range. This causes FileLoadException because the CLR cannot resolve the version mismatch.
Binding.0008.label: Assembly version mismatch with insufficient redirect coverage

WinFormsLegacyControls.description: Legacy Windows Forms controls that have been removed from .NET Core/5+ including StatusBar, DataGrid, ContextMenu, MainMenu, MenuItem, and ToolBar. These controls were replaced by more modern alternatives. Use ToolStrip, MenuStrip, ContextMenuStrip, and DataGridView instead.
WinFormsLegacyControls.label: Windows Forms Legacy Controls

ClickOnce.description: ClickOnce deployment technology for distributing Windows applications that is not available on .NET Core. Use alternative deployment methods such as self-contained deployments, Windows Package Manager, or third-party installers like WiX or InstallShield.
ClickOnce.label: ClickOnce Deployment

Binding.0006.description: An explicit binding redirect targets a different version than what auto-generation would produce. MSBuild will throw MSB3836 conflict error because it cannot determine which redirect wins.
Binding.0006.label: Manual redirect conflicts with auto-generated version
